title: clear()/signal_all_pending leave packet drops unaccounted in TxQueueStats
description: tx_queue.py:488-492: clear() -> signal_all_pending(False) removes N entries and resolves their reservations False but increments none of packets_dropped_deadline/preempt/full, so the CAD-terminal path (link_layer.py:1466), the radio-exception path (link_layer.py:1475), and the on_persistence_failure eviction (link_layer.py:2108) silently shrink the queue. The operator invariant packets_queued ~ transmitted + dropped no longer holds after any CAD-busy episode, masking loss when diagnosing congestion/failure modes. No hang or corruption - observability only. Fix: count removals in clear()/signal_all_pending under a dropped-other bucket (or reuse an existing counter deliberately). Distinct from project-LICHEN-worker6-m01y (silent-clear semantics) and project-LICHEN-lllg (stats += atomicity). Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-9qpz.
